survey: A green hiking backpack in three-quarter view, facing the camera, standing upright on the floor. Main body: a rounded green sack with a lime-trimmed top flap over the front. Two brown straps run from the top over the flap and pass through silver buckles near its lower edge. The strap ends hang below the buckles. Front pocket: a lower pocket with its own lime-trimmed flap, closed by two shorter brown straps with silver buckles. Its straps line up under the main straps. Side pockets: one rounded pocket with a flap on each side, sewn onto the body. Sleeping mat: a blue roll lying across the top of the pack, spiral end facing right. Two brown straps wrap around the mat and run down into the main flap straps. Shoulder strap: one brown strap is visible at the back right. It starts under the mat at the top and curves down to the bottom of the pack. The other strap is hidden behind the body. The pack's base rests flat on the floor and casts a contact shadow.
